description: React component for user login page, handling email input, organization selection, and authentication process including fetching user organizations and login via API.

methods.name: handleFindOrgs
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with the entered email, auto-selects 'Kavia B2C' if available, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleOrganizationSelect
methods.description: Handles manual selection of organization from dropdown, updates selected organization ID.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Performs login with selected organization, email, and password; handles success and error states.
